dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what's Bangkok like in the rainy season?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈlaɪk ɪn ðə ˈreɪni ˌsiːzən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: When it rains a lot, the streets flood.
dialogue.reading: wɛn ɪt ˈreɪnz ə ˈlɑːt, ðə ˈstriːts ˈflʌd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? How do you get to class?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈɡɛt tə ˈklæs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If the streets flood, I take the train.
dialogue.reading: ɪf ðə ˈstriːts ˈflʌd, aɪ ˈteɪk ðə ˈtreɪn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is it hot in the rainy season, too?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈhɑːt ɪn ðə ˈreɪni ˌsiːzən, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's hot and humid. When it's humid, I feel sticky.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈhɑːt ənd ˈhjuːmɪd. wɛn ɪts ˈhjuːmɪd, aɪ ˈfiːl ˈstɪki.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In the cool season. When it's dry, the weather is perfect.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ðə ˈkuːl ˌsiːzən. wɛn ɪts ˈdraɪ, ðə ˈwɛðər ɪz ˈpɜːrfɪkt.
